title: Chapter 335: All Hidden Dangers Eliminated
content:
Chapter 335: All Hidden Dangers Eliminated

Wu Qing used the Zerg army and the Protoss Arbitration Tribunal to solve the problems within the sphere of influence of the local camp. It will take time to capture the remaining territory of the evil god camp.

Wu Qing knew very well that those foreign evil gods were the biggest enemies of this world.

It was just that due to the limitations of the will of the universe, the foreign evil gods could not invest too much power in this world, giving this world a chance to survive.

The mysterious foreign power that gave birth to the weirdness might be the means of a foreign evil god.

Now with Wu Qing's intervention, the situation of the whole world began to change drastically, and this world began to recover. Those evil gods who were eyeing this world would definitely not let it go.

Wu Qing's pressure on the evil god camp was not enough, and those foreign evil gods had not started to take real action.

Taking advantage of this gap, Wu Qing also explored the underground world.

Although the weird lord of the Endless Mountains said it simply, Wu Qing could feel the specialness of the underground world. Such a special interlayer world must not be left alone.

After confirming that the people living in the underground world are basically the remnants of this world, Wu Qing stopped letting the Zerg army kill in the underground world.

With powerful power, there is no need to explore step by step as before.

A large number of Zerg hosts and Protoss unmanned probe spacecraft entered the underground world and explored the entire underground world.

Wu Qing and the Zerg and Protoss strongmen visited various races and powerful beings in the underground world based on the information collected by the Zerg hosts and Protoss unmanned probe spacecraft.

For the races and strongmen in the underground world that can be conquered, Wu Qing conquered them after showing his strength.

For those races and strongmen in the underground world who are unwilling to accept the management of the Zerg, Wu Qing can only defeat them one by one.

As long as they are normal intelligent creatures, they will generally choose to surrender under the threat of individual death and race survival.

There are also some who will not obey no matter what, Wu Qing will physically eliminate or mentally control them according to the situation.

What Wu Qing needs is a stable underground world. Only by clearing up all the hidden dangers in this world can he deal with external threats with peace of mind.

The underground world is very large, with a variety of races and creatures. It is much more difficult to conquer them all than to destroy a mezzanine world, and it takes a lot of time and energy.

Wu Qing participated in the early stage, and the Queen and the Archon were asked to command the Zerg and Protoss to carry out the task of conquering the underground world.

Wu Qing's harvest from conquering normal intelligent creatures is no less than that from directly destroying them, and it is also a sustainable harvest. Although it will be a little troublesome, it is still worth it.

More importantly, doing so will be supported by the will of the world rules. It is precisely because of the strong support of the will of the world rules that Wu Qing has saved a lot of time, allowing the Zerg and Protoss to develop to the current level in one step.

Wu Qing needs the will of the world rules to further open up his authority. Only in this way can the system use the authority of this world to exploit the loopholes of the will of the universe and bring him the greatest benefits.

Therefore, as long as it is beneficial to this world, Wu Qing will do it. He will do his best to help this world fight against foreign enemies and recover health.

Conquering an underground world obviously cannot meet Wu Qing's requirements.

This world has many powerful interlayer worlds like the underground world. All forces in this world have no power to occupy this kind of interlayer world, so it has become a powerful secret space.

Wu Qing obtained the location of these secret spaces from the local camp and the major weird lords, and sent powerful forces to conquer each secret space like conquering the underground world.

There are several such secret spaces in the Endless Mountains. Many races that have been defeated in the local camp choose to hide in such secret spaces and no longer ask about the outside world. This is the so-called seclusion.

In fact, these secluded races are also in crisis in the secret space, but compared with the evil god camp in the outside world, they are not as desperate.

Now the sources of system resources are diversified and the growth rate is very fast.

Wu Qing spent all the system resources he harvested, hatched and materialized a large number of Zerg and Protoss strongmen, entered various secret spaces, and strongly conquered the races and strongmen in each secret space.

Conquering the races and strong men in each secret space can bring a lot of resources to the system, thus forming a virtuous circle and supporting Wu Qing to control more interlayer spaces in this world.

Faced with the powerful Zerg, the races and strange lords of the local camp dared not have any objections.

Races including giants, humans, goblins and other super races in the local camp have acquiesced to the various actions of the Zerg.

Wu Qing's personal action to destroy the strange interlayer space made everyone see the huge gap between themselves and the Zerg, and they no longer had the spirit to compete with the Zerg.

Although the Zerg did not express it explicitly, the local camp has acquiesced to the status of the Zerg leader.

The will of the world rules is too partial to the Zerg, which makes all races have no way out.

However, under Wu Qing's command, the Zerg and Protoss kept doing practical things and did not interfere in the affairs of the local camp. Even the affiliated forces of the Zerg, such as the Great Xia Territory and the Alliance, worked hard and did not show off their status.

Wu Qing was not very interested in intervening in the affairs of the local camp. He did not get much practical benefits from so many things. It was better to stay out of it and do things according to his own ideas.

As long as the strength was sufficient, the world had to operate according to Wu Qing's will. He did not need those empty names that had no practical meaning.

The reputation of the Zerg no longer needed to be increased by commanding others.

The weird lords in various places, regardless of their strength, were all under the strong suppression of the Protoss Arbitration Tribunal. They were trembling with fear, fearing that the strong men of the Protoss Arbitration Tribunal would destroy them like ordinary weirds.

Even powerful weirds like the weird lords of the Endless Mountains did not dare to show any disrespect to the Protoss Arbitration Tribunal.

Each weird lord is restraining the weird under his rule. For those weirds that cannot be controlled, they actively ask the Protoss Arbitration Court to deal with them, and do not give the Protoss Arbitration Court any reason to deal with them.

After a period of efforts by the Zerg and the Protoss, all kinds of unstable factors within the sphere of influence of the native camp in this world have been cleared up.

Wu Qing can finally gather the forces of all parties and formally launch a full-scale counterattack against the evil god camp.
